chunks: 1590 - And ‘Amr ibn Jumay‘ narrated from him that he said:
No one paid zakat and it decreased his wealth, and no one withheld it and it increased in his wealth.

key_terms.الزَّكَاةَ: zakat, the obligatory alms due on wealth
key_terms.مَنَعَهَا: withheld it or refused to give it

ai.seo_question: Does paying zakat reduce a person’s wealth or withholding it increase wealth?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches that paying zakat does not truly diminish a person's wealth, while withholding it does not bring real increase. It emphasizes trust in Allah’s blessing and encourages fulfillment of financial obligations with certainty and sincerity.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.1590 - Amr ibn Jumei' reported from him (Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as)) who said:
"No one ever paid Zakat, and their wealth decreased because of it, nor did anyone withhold it, and their wealth increased because of it."
